verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for an AI assistant and API service like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any choice of storage region or data residency. The items cover coding tools, models, API keys, pricing and community opinions of model quality, none of which bear on where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
